title.justification: The extracted title 'Conditional Permutation Invariant Flows' is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper as the main topic of research.
title.quote: Abstract We present a conditional generative probabilistic model of set-valued data with a tractable log density.

extractions.description: This paper introduces a conditional generative model using permutation invariant flows for set-valued data, applied to tasks like traffic scene generation and object bounding box estimation. The method involves a conditional normalizing flow with permutation equivariant dynamics, leveraging deep neural networks for learning. The paper demonstrates improved performance in realistic traffic scene generation and object bounding box prediction compared to non-permutation invariant models.
